lines.3: Normally, the wall was too high to climb.
lines.4: But there were four of us.
lines.5: First, Subaru faced the wall and planted his hands against it.
lines.6: The rest of us climbed onto Subaru's shoulders, jumped from there, and hauled ourselves up the wall.
lines.7: Subaru could jump high enough on his own that I could catch his outstretched hand and pull him the rest of the way up.
lines.8: To keep me from falling while I did it, Fukahire and Crab held me steady with a firm grip on each shoulder.
lines.9: And just like that, all four of us were on top of the wall.
lines.10: We successfully infiltrated the rear of the school grounds.
